notes: City of DuBois and Sandy Township consolidated base zoning districts (68 polygons), hosted by the consultant for the DuBois-Sandy Joint Board. Sandy Twp merged into DuBois as a city in Jan 2026. Covers only the DuBois/Sandy area, not the whole county.
